attributes.text: I'm an optician in Birmingham, buying from the same suppliers as the high street and pricing it more sensibly. If you need your prescription in them, I glaze and fit the lenses myself.

attributes.content: Four reasons, and not one of them is a discount code.

attributes.text: I'm an optician who genuinely enjoys this part of the job — finding people frames that suit them. This shop exists so I can show you the whole range properly instead of scrolling a supplier's catalogue at the counter, and because I'd rather price frames fairly than squeeze the most out of every sale.

attributes.content: Below RRP, and I show you by how much

attributes.text: The recommended retail price sits next to my price on every single frame. No codes to hunt for, no countdown timers, no permanent fake sale.
Your prescription doesn't get posted off to a lab in another county. I cut, fit and check the lenses here — which is also how I spot a frame that won't work before it's made.
One optician, one WhatsApp number. Ask me anything about a frame or a prescription before you spend a penny.

attributes.content: Collect in Birmingham, or posted tracked

attributes.text: Come and pick them up and I'll adjust them to you properly. Or free tracked delivery over £75.

attributes.content: I'm Fatima Nawaz, and I run the clinic in Birmingham.

attributes.text: Everything on this site I chose myself, and every prescription order comes across my bench before it's made. If a frame isn't going to work with your lenses, I'd rather tell you before you pay than after.
If you're unsure about anything, just ask. Talking people through frames and lenses is what I do all day at the clinic, and I'm glad to do it here too.
